reports.title: Anglers continue to catch bluegill, bass and catfish throughout the day
reports.text: Anglers continue to catch bluegill, bass and catfish throughout the day. A few bass have been caught on 3-inch craws and Ned rigs.

reports.title: Lake Mohave Fishing Report
reports.text: Largemouth bass are taking soft plastics in the shallows, while smallmouth bass are hitting walking baits early in the day.
